posts.name: arenson9
posts.cooked:
arenson9:

 

Pydro wrote:
Why aren't mods inherently playtesters like admins?  
Is there a mod who is not a playtester?

Oh, wait. I think you are noticing that the people who are Admins don't also have playtester badges, but the people who are Mods DO also have playtester badges, concluding that it's possible to be a Mod w/out being a playtester, and asking why that is possible.

 

I don't know for sure, but I think the reason is that the way the forums work, various abilities are tied to various roles, the admin role gives one the ability to do anything, the mod role gives one the ability to do various things to posts that the mod can see, and the playtester role gives one the ability to see some forums that not everyone can see. In order for people who have the mod role to be able to see the playtester forums without also having the playtester role, presumably the mod role would have to be altered. I don't know how hard it would be to alter that role, or if there might have been some interest in keeping mods from seeing some forums in the future, but my guess is that the real reason things work the way they do is because it was easy to configure the software this way.
